subject: french
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in French on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (French↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.explain: 'Je suis fatigué' = 'I am tired'. 'Fatigant' means 'tiring', a near-miss distractor.
« Un séjour » means a stay (e.g. « un séjour d'une semaine » = a one-week stay). A journey is « un trajet/voyage ».
'Un chanteur' is a male singer (female: 'une chanteuse'); 'a song' is 'une chanson'.

questions.q: What does 'le mot de passe' mean?
questions.explain: 'Le mot de passe' literally 'the word of passing' means 'the password'.
« Un abonnement » means a subscription, e.g. « un abonnement à une plateforme de streaming ».
False friend: 'une émission' is a TV/radio programme, not an 'emission'.
« Un écran » means a screen, e.g. « le temps d'écran » = screen time.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We celebrate Christmas with the family'?
questions.explain: 'Fêter' = 'to celebrate' and 'en famille' = 'with the family', so 'On fête Noël en famille' is correct.
'Le réchauffement climatique' means 'global warming / climate warming'.

questions.q: What does « le muguet » traditionally given on 1 May refer to?
questions.explain: « Le muguet » (lily of the valley) is offered on « le 1er mai » (Labour Day) as a good-luck charm.

options: Giving a refreshing change of scene
questions.explain: « Dépaysant » describes something that gives a pleasant change of scenery / takes you out of your usual surroundings.
« Les actualités » (« les infos ») means the news. Linked to the faux ami « actuel » = current.
'Télécharger' means 'to download' (and can mean upload with 'téléverser'/'mettre en ligne').
